description:
Lift two rejections in tag_engine.ex and implement slot collection.

## Changes

**lib/filament/tag_engine.ex**

**Step A** — Remote component inner content
- Add handler for `{:remote_component, name, attrs, tag_meta}` open-tag form (non-self-closing)
- Walk tokens until matching closing tag, collecting `<:slot_name>` sub-trees
- Emit component vnode with slot entries injected into assigns

**Step B** — `<:slot_name>...</:slot_name>` collector (replaces raise_syntax_error! at line 520)
- Parse open slot sub-tag, collect inner VNode tree until matching close
- Build quoted zero-arity lambda (`render_fn`) over the inner AST; it captures caller's `assigns`
- Produce `%Filament.Slot.Entry{render_fn: fn, attrs: attrs_map}`

**New module: lib/filament/slot/entry.ex**
```elixir
defmodule Filament.Slot.Entry do
  defstruct [:render_fn, :attrs]
  @type t :: %__MODULE__{render_fn: (-> Filament.VNode.t()), attrs: map()}
end
```

## Acceptance
- `<MyComp><:header>...</:header></MyComp>` compiles without error
- Bare content at top level of component tag raises compile-time error with helpful message
- Unknown slot name raises compile-time error when target module is resolvable
title: Tag engine: consumer <:slot_name> and remote component inner content
